content.body: The engine has been significantly upgraded. We've introduced the **OnStart Up Modal** enabling you as editors with the ability to see what's happening in concern for the **WASM Video Editor** on different types of things such as:

We can now show news and other great updates made within the editor such as this **OnStart Up Modal Window**! So if we have new upgrades for the video editor, such as the *Ghost App Installer*, we can now mention that here, or any other new features, events that are coming up or so on.

We are planning to enable **Hardware Acceleration** within the **Ghost App Installer** to allow for GPU processing which should reduce the CPU overhead that is happening with the engine, making it more performant and less likely to freeze up your editor, and computer.

So look forward to that installer update coming soon! [img] (https://github.com/Cleo876/wasm-video-editor/blob/main/IMGs/Meta-Data/WASM%20Video%20Editor%20META-DATA%20WallPaper.png?raw=true) [right]
